cues.title: Mystery
cues.narration_text: Tooth decay starts before a hole. What tips the balance?

cues.title: Acid pressure
cues.narration_text: Some bacteria in plaque use sugars to make acids. Repeated exposure can keep enamel losing minerals.

cues.title: Repair response
cues.narration_text: Saliva and fluoride help replace lost minerals. Early decay can sometimes be stopped or reversed before a cavity forms.

cues.title: Threshold
cues.narration_text: If loss keeps winning, the surface can break down. A formed cavity needs dental assessment and appropriate treatment.

cues.title: Restoration
cues.narration_text: A dentist assesses the tooth and selects treatment. A filling is one common way to restore damaged structure.

cues.title: Prevention
cues.narration_text: The long game is prevention: fluoride toothpaste twice daily, cleaning between teeth, and regular dental review.
